title: FORNABODA built-in dishwasher
description: FORNABODA built-in dishwasher, panel-ready, 24" The more the merrier – this dishwasher swallows bulky pots and up to 14 place settings depending on how you adapt the racks and you can set the programmed to start at a later time when it suits you. A sound signal indicates when a program is finished.
features: Installation to be carried out by a qualified installer.
You will find complete information about the installation and use of this product under the tab Assembly instructions & documents.
This model is designed for built-in installation.
Countertop, door, plinth and handles are sold separately.
Upper basket fits plates with a diameter up to 9".
Lower basket fits plates with a diameter up to 11".
